# Output Rules

- Keep outputs concise and structured
- Avoid unnecessary markdown tables
- Prefer compact summaries over verbose explanations
- Include only actionable findings
- Avoid filler text and roleplay narration
- Use deterministic formatting where possible
- Minimize token usage while preserving clarity
- Show only modified sections when updating files
- Prefer bullet points over large prose blocks

## Compression Rules

- Do not restate previously known requirements
- Reference REQ-IDs and F-IDs instead of repeating full descriptions
- Summarize prior agent outputs instead of restating them
- Keep handoffs concise and actionable
- Avoid repeating state already present in the state file
- Prefer concise summaries over large tables where possible
- Compress completed workflow sections when safe
